description: 600 条文生图提示语 · 60 类 · 覆盖权重语法 / 镜头 / 光线 / 风格 / 构图

items.prompt: portrait of a young woman, long wavy hair, (freckles:1.2), soft smile, cinematic lighting, 85mm portrait, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, masterpiece, best quality
items.tip: 用 (词:1.2) 强化雀斑细节；85mm 人像镜头 + 浅景深控制虚化。
items.subject: portrait of a young woman

items.prompt: (close-up:1.3) of an elderly fisherman, weathered skin, deep wrinkles, sea wind in hair, golden hour, dramatic rim light, 8k, ultra-detailed
items.tip: 给构图词 close-up 加权拉近；weathered/wrinkles 堆质感，rim light 勾轮廓。
items.subject: close-up

items.prompt: a girl, (iriya:1.1), school uniform, cherry blossom petals, anime style, cel shading, vibrant colors, studio lighting
items.tip: 角色名/触发词单独加权，常用于角色 LoRA 与 Textual Inversion；cel shading 指定平涂。
items.subject: a girl

items.prompt: full body shot, female warrior in ornate silver armor, holding a glowing spear, confident pose, dramatic backlight, fantasy, concept art, ArtStation trending
items.tip: full body 锁定全身构图；概念艺术 + 平台热词提升风格倾向。
items.subject: full body shot

items.prompt: a man in business suit, confident, city skyline bokeh background, (looking at viewer:1.2), professional headshot, softbox lighting, photorealistic
items.tip: 对视线方向加权，比反复写 face/eyes 更稳；softbox 指定商业布光。
items.subject: a man in business suit

items.prompt: woman with (rainbow hair:1.2), cyberpunk fashion, neon reflections on skin, night, futuristic, synthwave, hyperdetailed
items.tip: 非现实发色必须加权才不易被模型「纠正」回自然色。
items.subject: woman with rainbow hair

items.prompt: baby laughing, chubby cheeks, soft blanket, warm window light, adorable, realistic, shallow DOF, bokeh
items.tip: 情绪动词 laughing + 可爱度词共同驱动表情；暖窗光定调。
items.subject: baby laughing

items.prompt: [old man:young man:0.5], standing in a field, oil painting style, visible brush strokes
items.tip: [from:to:0.5] 分步替换：前 50% 步画老人、后 50% 画青年，得到融合年龄。
items.subject: old man

items.prompt: (face focus:1.4), asian woman, elegant, traditional hanfu, red and gold, soft studio light, 8k, highly detailed skin
items.tip: 把抽象构图意图 face focus 当成可加权词，配合皮肤质感词。
items.subject: face focus

items.prompt: crowd of diverse people, street photography, candid, natural lighting, 35mm, documentary style, grain
items.tip: 纪实摄影调性靠 documentary + grain；35mm 广角交代环境。
items.subject: crowd of diverse people

items.prompt: woman, (silhouette:1.2), backlit by sunset, rim lighting, dramatic, moody atmosphere, cinematic
items.tip: 剪影 + 逆光组合，用少量词建立强情绪。
items.subject: woman

items.prompt: male elf archer, intricate leather armor, glowing arrow, ancient forest, dappled light, fantasy illustration, sharp focus
items.tip: 幻想角色给「道具 + 材质 + 光斑」三件套，比空写 fantasy 更具体。
items.subject: male elf archer

items.prompt: (split screen:1.1), left side calm, right side angry, same person, studio lighting, photorealistic
items.tip: 把分屏当作构图词加权，左右语义用逗号并列描述。
items.subject: split screen

items.prompt: a portrait in the style of (Leonardo da Vinci:1.2) and (modern photography:0.8), sfumato, soft light, renaissance
items.tip: 多风格分别给主次权重；sfumato 这类专业术语能精准调风格。
items.subject: a portrait in the style of Leonardo da Vinci

items.prompt: woman with glasses, reading a book, cozy cafe, warm ambient light, depth of field, photorealistic, 8k
items.tip: 日常场景靠「动作 + 环境光」建立生活感，不必堆画质词。
items.subject: woman with glasses

items.prompt: (mountain landscape:1.3), snow-capped peaks, alpine lake reflection, golden hour, dramatic clouds, national geographic, ultra-wide, 8k
items.tip: 主体加权 + 倒影构图 + 杂志级风格词，风景三板斧。
items.subject: mountain landscape

items.prompt: tropical beach, turquoise water, white sand, palm trees, clear sky, bright sunlight, vacation photo, wide angle, highly detailed
items.tip: 用具体颜色词 turquoise 而非 blue，色彩更可控。
items.subject: tropical beach

items.prompt: forest path, ancient trees, fog, (god rays:1.2), mystical atmosphere, cinematic lighting, photorealistic
items.tip: 雾 + 耶稣光加权，是神秘森林最省词的配方。
items.subject: forest path

items.prompt: (aerial view:1.2), winding river through canyon, red rock formations, sunset, drone photography, ultra-detailed
items.tip: 视角词前置并加权，直接决定整张图的透视。
items.subject: aerial view

items.prompt: (aurora borealis:1.3) over snowy mountains, starry sky, milky way, long exposure, night photography, 8k
items.tip: 极光加权；long exposure 触发长曝光夜景质感。
items.subject: aurora borealis

items.prompt: desert dunes, camel caravan, heat haze, sunset, golden sand, cinematic, vast scale, ultra-wide shot
items.tip: heat haze 制造热浪扰动；vast scale 拉宏大尺度。
items.subject: desert dunes

items.prompt: japanese garden, koi pond, cherry blossoms, stone lantern, soft light, peaceful, photorealistic, shallow depth of field
items.tip: 文化元素清单式罗列，配合「平和」情绪词统一氛围。
items.subject: japanese garden

items.prompt: (waterfall:1.2) in lush rainforest, mist, ferns, tropical birds, vibrant green, bright, ultra-detailed
items.tip: 水雾 + 植被层次 + 色彩饱和度一起写。
items.subject: waterfall

items.prompt: autumn forest, red and orange leaves, sunbeams through trees, ground covered in leaves, warm tones, peaceful, 8k
items.tip: 季节色 + warm tones 全局定调，避免颜色打架。
items.subject: autumn forest

items.prompt: icelandic black sand beach, dramatic waves, basalt columns, overcast sky, moody, cinematic wide shot
items.tip: 写具体地名/地貌，比泛写 beach 更有辨识度。
items.subject: icelandic black sand beach

items.prompt: (underwater scene:1.2), coral reef, tropical fish, crystal clear water, sun rays from surface, hyperdetailed
items.tip: 水下场景要补「水面入射光」，否则容易发灰。
items.subject: underwater scene

items.prompt: rolling hills at dawn, dewy grass, soft pink sky, mist in valleys, peaceful, landscape photography, 8k
items.tip: 黎明柔光 + 露水细节，靠时间词控制色温。
items.subject: rolling hills at dawn

items.prompt: (volcano eruption:1.3), lava flowing, smoke plume, night, dramatic red glow, cinematic, ultra-wide
items.tip: 灾害主体强加权，再用单一红光统一夜景。
items.subject: volcano eruption

items.prompt: misty mountains layered in the distance, traditional chinese ink painting style, minimal, elegant, negative space
items.tip: 水墨风 + negative space 留白，减法构图。
items.subject: misty mountains layered in the distance

items.prompt: field of lavender, endless purple rows, provence, golden hour, bees, dreamy, photorealistic, ultra-detailed
items.tip: 地名 Provence 触发典型色彩记忆；bees 增加细节密度。
items.subject: field of lavender

items.prompt: majestic lion, african savanna, tall grass, golden hour, intense gaze, wildlife photography, 600mm lens, sharp
items.tip: 600mm 长焦是野生动物摄影的标志性写法。
items.subject: majestic lion

items.prompt: (eagle in flight:1.2), wings spread wide, mountain backdrop, dramatic sky, motion blur on wings, hyperdetailed
items.tip: 动作加权 + 局部运动模糊，静态图也能有速度感。
items.subject: eagle in flight

items.prompt: cute kitten, big eyes, fluffy fur, sitting on windowsill, soft sunlight, adorable, photorealistic, 8k
items.tip: fluffy fur 专攻毛绒质感，配合可爱度词。
items.subject: cute kitten

items.prompt: (wolf howling:1.2) at full moon, snowy forest, cold blue light, dramatic, cinematic, detailed fur
items.tip: 情绪动作 + 冷色调情境，一条词讲完故事。
items.subject: wolf howling

items.prompt: colorful peacock, feathers fully spread, iridescent, garden background, vibrant, ultra-detailed, sharp focus
items.tip: iridescent 虹彩质感词，专治羽毛/金属/贝壳。
items.subject: colorful peacock

items.prompt: (dolphin jumping:1.1) out of ocean, splash, tropical sun, blue water, dynamic, wildlife photography
items.tip: 抓拍瞬间 + 水花细节，动态词 dynamic 辅助。
items.subject: dolphin jumping

items.prompt: giant panda eating bamboo, adorable, soft light, photorealistic, shallow depth of field, 8k
items.tip: 行为细节比静态站姿更生动；景深收掉杂乱背景。
items.subject: giant panda eating bamboo

items.prompt: (dragon:1.3), fire breathing, massive wings, dark fantasy, intricate scales, dramatic lighting, epic, concept art
items.tip: 幻想生物强加权 + 鳞片纹理 + 史诗概念艺术。
items.subject: dragon

items.prompt: chameleon on branch, color-shifting skin, tropical, macro photography, extreme detail, vivid colors
items.tip: macro photography 切微距，细节密度立刻上一个量级。
items.subject: chameleon on branch

items.prompt: (flock of birds:1.2) flying at sunset, silhouette, dramatic sky, cinematic wide shot, golden and purple tones
items.tip: 群体构图 + 剪影 + 撞色，宽幅最有张力。
items.subject: flock of birds

items.prompt: (futuristic city:1.3), neon lights, towering skyscrapers, flying cars, cyberpunk night, rain, reflections, 8k
items.tip: 赛博夜景三件套：霓虹、雨、地面反射。
items.subject: futuristic city

items.prompt: gothic cathedral, intricate stained glass, towering spires, dramatic light beams, interior wide shot, photorealistic
items.tip: 彩窗光束 + 内景广角，写出建筑体积感。
items.subject: gothic cathedral

items.prompt: (japanese temple:1.2), cherry blossoms, stone path, soft sunlight, peaceful, traditional architecture, ultra-detailed
items.tip: 建筑主体加权，季节元素做氛围叠加。
items.subject: japanese temple

items.prompt: ancient greek ruins, marble columns, blue sky, olive trees, golden hour, historical, cinematic wide shot
items.tip: 材质 marble + 历史形容词，避免建筑风格漂移。
items.subject: ancient greek ruins

items.prompt: (modern minimalist house:1.2), glass walls, infinity pool, desert mountains, sunset, architecture photography, clean lines
items.tip: clean lines 是极简建筑的高频有效词。
items.subject: modern minimalist house

items.prompt: cozy cottage, thatched roof, smoke from chimney, snowy village, warm window light, fairytale, storybook illustration
items.tip: 暖窗光对冷雪景，是童话插画的经典对比。
items.subject: cozy cottage

items.prompt: (interior of library:1.2), tall wooden bookshelves, warm lamps, cozy reading nooks, classical, detailed, cinematic
items.tip: 内景先写光源（warm lamps），再写陈设。
items.subject: interior of library

items.prompt: space station interior, futuristic corridors, glowing panels, zero gravity, sci-fi, clean design, hyperdetailed
items.tip: 发光面板 + 失重，用物理状态词强化科幻感。
items.subject: space station interior

items.prompt: (venice canal:1.1), gondola, historic buildings, golden reflection on water, sunset, romantic, photorealistic, 8k
items.tip: 地标 + 水面倒影 + 情绪词 romantic。
items.subject: venice canal

items.prompt: (isometric city:1.2), low poly style, pastel colors, miniature, clean, 3d render, soft lighting
items.tip: isometric 等距视角 + low poly，一秒切 3D 小景。
items.subject: isometric city

items.prompt: portrait of a woman, (oil painting:1.2), visible brush strokes, rich colors, classical renaissance style, masterpiece
items.tip: 画种加权 + 笔触可见，比只写 oil painting 更像油画。
items.subject: portrait of a woman

items.prompt: landscape, (watercolor:1.3), wet-on-wet, ink washes, soft edges, white paper texture, artistic, loose style
items.tip: 湿画法 wet-on-wet 与纸纹是水彩的关键限定词。
items.subject: landscape

items.prompt: cityscape, (impressionism:1.2), dappled light, vibrant brush strokes, monet style, outdoor scene, 8k
items.tip: 流派 + 画家名双触发，风格更锁定。
items.subject: cityscape

items.prompt: portrait, (pixel art:1.3), 16-bit, retro game style, dithering, limited palette, nostalgic
items.tip: dithering 抖动 + limited palette 限定色板，像素味才正。
items.subject: portrait

items.prompt: character, (comic book style:1.2), bold outlines, halftone dots, vibrant inks, dynamic pose, pop art
items.tip: halftone dots 半调网点是美漫印刷感的来源。
items.subject: character

items.prompt: scene, (3d render:1.2), octane render, unreal engine 5, ray tracing, subsurface scattering, hyperrealistic, 8k
items.tip: 渲染引擎名 + 次表面散射，专攻皮肤/蜡质通透感。
items.subject: scene

items.prompt: portrait, (charcoal sketch:1.2), hand-drawn, cross-hatching, monochrome, rough paper, artistic study
items.tip: cross-hatching 交叉排线决定素描的「手绘感」。
items.subject: portrait

items.prompt: landscape, (ukiyo-e:1.2), japanese woodblock print, flat colors, bold outlines, hokusai style, waves
items.tip: woodblock print 版画工艺词 + 平涂限定。
items.subject: landscape

items.prompt: portrait, (pop surrealism:1.2), dreamlike, vibrant colors, margaret keane eyes, lowbrow art, whimsical
items.tip: 用特征词 Keane eyes 精确引用某种视觉符号。
items.subject: portrait

items.prompt: scene, (low poly:1.3), geometric, faceted, pastel gradient background, minimalist 3d, soft ambient occlusion
items.tip: ambient occlusion 环境光遮蔽让低多边形不「飘」。
items.subject: scene

items.prompt: portrait, (art nouveau:1.2), decorative patterns, elegant curves, alphonse mucha, poster style, ornate
items.tip: 新艺术靠装饰曲线 + 海报构图，而非人物本身。
items.subject: portrait

items.prompt: landscape, (cyberpunk anime:1.2), neon, cel shading, blade runner, japanese aesthetic, vibrant night
items.tip: 平涂 + 霓虹 + 电影名，混合风格分别落词。
items.subject: landscape

items.prompt: portrait, (double exposure:1.2), blended with forest, artistic, dreamlike, conceptual photography, ethereal
items.tip: 双重曝光是构图技法，可直接当提示词用。
items.subject: portrait

items.prompt: scene, (vaporwave:1.2), 80s aesthetic, pink and cyan grid, retro computer, glitch, distorted, lo-fi
items.tip: 年代美学 + 故障艺术，靠配色和道具锁定。
items.subject: scene

items.prompt: portrait, (renaissance oil:1.1) + (modern neon:0.6), mixed media, striking contrast, avant-garde, gallery
items.tip: 用 + 连接两个独立权重块，做主次分明的东西方混搭。
items.subject: portrait

items.prompt: portrait, (85mm lens:1.2), f/1.4, shallow DOF, sharp eyes, blurred background, professional photography, 8k
items.tip: 焦距 + 光圈 f/1.4 一起写，景深最可预测。
items.subject: portrait

items.prompt: street scene, (wide angle 24mm:1.2), distorted perspective, dynamic, urban photography, candid, natural light
items.tip: 广角畸变本身可作为风格，不必回避。
items.subject: street scene

items.prompt: (telephoto compression:1.1), city skyline, layered buildings, 200mm, sharp, haze, architectural photography
items.tip: 长焦压缩把远景「压」成层次。
items.subject: telephoto compression

items.prompt: portrait, (golden hour:1.3), warm side light, long shadows, lens flare, cinematic, romantic, photorealistic
items.tip: 黄金时刻 + 镜头光晕，一套词定全天色温。
items.subject: portrait

items.prompt: scene, (blue hour:1.2), city lights, twilight sky, moody, reflections on wet street, cinematic night photography
items.tip: 蓝调时刻与湿街反射是夜景最稳的组合。
items.subject: scene

items.prompt: still life, (studio lighting:1.2), softbox, seamless backdrop, product photography, sharp, commercial, 8k
items.tip: 无缝背景 seamless backdrop 是产品图标志词。
items.subject: still life

items.prompt: portrait, (rim lighting:1.2), dark background, glowing edge, dramatic, moody, low key photography
items.tip: low key 暗调摄影，靠轮廓光把主体从黑底里剥出来。
items.subject: portrait

items.prompt: scene, (high key:1.2), bright white, soft pastel, minimal shadows, airy, dreamy, fashion photography
items.tip: high key 高调：亮、柔、少阴影，与 low key 正好相反。
items.subject: scene

items.prompt: (macro photography:1.3), dewdrop on leaf, refracted miniature world, extreme detail, shallow DOF, 8k
items.tip: 微距 + 折射小世界，用构思代替堆细节词。
items.subject: macro photography

items.prompt: portrait, (dramatic chiaroscuro:1.2), strong contrast, single light source, caravaggio style, painterly
items.tip: 明暗对照法 + 单光源，古典绘画光直接迁移到摄影。
items.subject: portrait

items.prompt: (spaceship:1.2) hovering over alien planet, two moons, ringed planet in sky, sci-fi, epic, matte painting, 8k
items.tip: 天体外景 + matte painting 电影绘景词。
items.subject: spaceship

items.prompt: (floating island:1.3), waterfalls into sky, fantasy, lush vegetation, golden light, epic, concept art, ArtStation
items.tip: 反重力构思靠主体强加权才不会被引力「修正」。
items.subject: floating island

items.prompt: cyborg warrior, (mechanical details:1.2), glowing cybernetic eye, neon-lit alley, rain, Blade Runner style, hyperdetailed
items.tip: 机械细节加权，避免赛博格变成普通人脸。
items.subject: cyborg warrior

items.prompt: (dragon's lair:1.2), treasure hoard, dark cave, golden glow, atmospheric, epic fantasy, detailed, cinematic
items.tip: 写「场景 + 叙事道具」，比只写 dragon 更有故事。
items.subject: dragon's lair

items.prompt: alien landscape, (bioluminescent plants:1.3), glowing mushrooms, purple and teal, strange creatures, otherworldly
items.tip: 生物荧光 + 异星配色，otherworldly 收束整体调性。
items.subject: alien landscape

items.prompt: (robot portrait:1.2), humanoid chrome face, reflective metal, studio light, sleek design, photorealistic, 8k
items.tip: 镀铬反射必须配 studio light 才有金属感。
items.subject: robot portrait

items.prompt: wizard casting spell, (magic particles:1.2), glowing runes, ancient robes, dark forest, fantasy illustration, detailed
items.tip: 粒子 + 发光符文，把「施法」可视化。
items.subject: wizard casting spell

items.prompt: (post-apocalyptic city:1.2), overgrown ruins, rusted vehicles, fog, muted colors, atmospheric, cinematic wide shot
items.tip: 锈蚀 + 低饱和，末世感靠材质与色彩而非废墟堆砌。
items.subject: post-apocalyptic city

items.prompt: (underwater city:1.2), domed structures, exotic fish, rays of light, futuristic, fantasy, hyperdetailed, 8k
items.tip: 穹顶结构 + 穿透光线，水下科幻的空间感来源。
items.subject: underwater city

items.prompt: gnome village, (tiny houses:1.2), mushrooms, fairy lights, magical atmosphere, storybook, whimsical, detailed
items.tip: 微缩尺度词 tiny + 童话光源，奇想调性一目了然。
items.subject: gnome village

items.prompt: (product shot:1.3), perfume bottle on marble, soft reflection, studio light, advertising, clean, commercial, 8k
items.tip: 产品广告：反射台面 + 干净背景 + 商业感词。
items.subject: product shot

items.prompt: (logo design:1.2), minimalist, geometric, flat vector, white background, clean, modern, graphic design
items.tip: flat vector + white background 是标志设计的硬约束。
items.subject: logo design

items.prompt: (isometric room:1.2), cozy interior, plants, warm light, lo-fi aesthetic, 3d render, soft colors
items.tip: 等距房间 + lo-fi，适合做壁纸与插画素材。
items.subject: isometric room

items.prompt: (vertical phone wallpaper:1.2), mountain landscape, minimalist, pastel, 9:16, aesthetic, soft light
items.tip: 把画幅 9:16 写进提示词，配合输出分辨率锁定竖构图。
items.subject: vertical phone wallpaper

items.prompt: (t-shirt design:1.2), centered graphic, vintage skull roses, flat colors, screen print, white background
items.tip: screen print 丝网印刷，限定印花工艺质感。
items.subject: t-shirt design

items.prompt: (tattoo design:1.2), fine line, blackwork, geometric mandala, minimalist, body art, white background
items.tip: fine line blackwork 是纹身稿的精确风格词。
items.subject: tattoo design

items.prompt: (icon:1.2), app icon, rounded square, glossy, gradient, sparkles, clean, modern UI design
items.tip: 圆角方形 + 光泽渐变，UI 图标的结构约束。
items.subject: icon

items.prompt: (pattern design:1.2), seamless floral, repeating, watercolor, pastel, textile, tileable, decorative
items.tip: seamless / tileable 让模型理解「可平铺」。
items.subject: pattern design

items.prompt: (book cover:1.2), fantasy novel, dramatic title space, dark forest, glowing eyes, cinematic, atmospheric
items.tip: 预留标题空间 title space，是封面构图的实用技巧。
items.subject: book cover

items.prompt: (poster:1.2), movie poster style, centered figure, dramatic lighting, negative space for text, cinematic, 8k
items.tip: negative space for text 主动为后期排版留白。
items.subject: poster

items.prompt: portrait, (large text "HELLO" in neon:1.2), woman with neon sign, cyberpunk, night, 8k
items.tip: 提示词内指定文字内容；SD1.5 较弱，SDXL/FLUX 更可靠。
items.subject: portrait

items.prompt: scene, [cat:dog:0.5], sitting on chair, soft light, photorealistic
items.tip: [from:to:step] 分步替换，可生成猫狗过渡形态。
items.subject: scene

items.prompt: portrait, <lora:detail_tweaker:0.8>, masterpiece, best quality, ultra-detailed, woman, elegant, studio light
items.tip: <lora:名称:权重> 挂载 LoRA，权重常取 0.5~0.9。
items.subject: portrait

items.prompt: (masterpiece, best quality:1.2), (intricate details:1.1), (8k:1.1), scene description here, ultra-detailed, award-winning
items.tip: 把画质词打包成可复用增强前缀，统一加权。
items.subject: masterpiece

items.prompt: (subject:1.2), (detail:1.1), [weak detail], environment, lighting, camera, style, quality tags
items.tip: 综合模板：加权 / 弱化 / 结构分层 / 风格 / 画质一次排好，替换括号即可复用。
items.subject: subject

items.prompt: (steaming ramen bowl:1.35), wooden table, warm window light, food photography, (cinematic lighting:1.2), 8k, ultra-detailed
